title.zh: 卷343 列傳一百三十 书麟弟：广厚 觉罗吉庆 觉罗长麟 费淳 百龄 伯麟
title.en: Volume 343 Biographies 130: Shu Lin Younger Brother: Guang Hou, Jue Luo Ji Qing, Jue Luo Zhang Lin, Fei Chun, Bai Ling, Bo Lin
title.raw: 卷343 列傳一百三十 书麟弟：广厚 觉罗吉庆 觉罗长麟 费淳 百龄 伯麟

sentences.zh: 書麟，字紱齋，高佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，大學士高晉子。

translations.literal: Shu Lin, style name Fuzhai, of the Gao clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, was the son of Grand Secretary Gao Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Lin, whose style was Fuzhai, belonged to the Gao clan and the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner; he was the son of Grand Secretary Gao Jin.

sentences.zh: 初授鑾儀衛整儀尉，累遷冠軍使，擢西安副都統。

translations.literal: At first he was appointed orderly officer of the Imperial Procession Guard, was promoted repeatedly to champion commissioner, and was raised to vice commander-in-chief at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: He began as an orderly officer in the Imperial Procession Guard, rose through successive posts to champion commissioner, and was then appointed vice commander-in-chief at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十八年，大軍徵金川，命為領隊大臣，從參贊大臣豐升額，力戰輒先登，克堅碉數十，功最。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year of Qianlong, when the great army campaigned against Jinchuan, he was ordered to serve as lead commander, following the participating commander Feng Sheng'e; in fierce fighting he was always first to scale the walls, captured several dozen strong blockhouses, and his merit was greatest.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 38, during the great campaign against Jinchuan, he was made lead commander under Participating Commander Feng Sheng'e. In hard fighting he repeatedly led the assault, took dozens of fortified blockhouses, and earned the highest distinction.

sentences.zh: 金川平，加等議敘，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, he received an extra-grade merit review and had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan was pacified, he was granted an enhanced merit award and his likeness was enshrined in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 授廣西巡撫，以父憂去。

translations.literal: He was appointed governor of Guangxi, then left office on account of his father's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed governor of Guangxi but resigned when his father died.

sentences.zh: 起，署兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Recalled from mourning, he served as acting vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: When recalled from mourning, he served as acting vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，出為安徽巡撫，歲旱，請留漕糧五萬石、關稅銀三十五萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year he went out as governor of Anhui; the year was drought-stricken, and he requested that fifty thousand piculs of grain transport tax and three hundred fifty thousand taels of customs silver be retained for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year he became governor of Anhui. During a drought he asked to retain fifty thousand piculs of transport grain and 350,000 taels of customs revenue for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 阜陽有荒地六千餘頃，疏請寬限清釐，民間交易用官弓丈量，以杜欺隱，期於漸復舊額。

translations.literal: In Fuyang there were more than six thousand qing of wasteland; he memorialized asking for an extended deadline for clearance and survey, that private transactions use the official measuring bow to prevent fraud and concealment, and that the old quota be gradually restored.
translations.idiomatic: More than six thousand qing of wasteland lay in Fuyang. He memorialized for a longer deadline to clear and register it, required private land sales to be measured with the official bow to curb fraud, and aimed to restore the original tax quota over time.

sentences.zh: 帝以書麟盡心民瘼，予優敘。

translations.literal: The emperor, because Shu Lin devoted himself to the people's hardships, granted him a superior merit review.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rewarded him with a superior merit review for his devoted attention to the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 黃、運兩河漫溢，帝因兩江總督李世傑未諳河工，命書麟佐之。

translations.literal: The Yellow and Grand Canal rivers overflowed; because the governor-general of the Two Jiangs, Li Shijie, was not versed in river works, the emperor ordered Shu Lin to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow River and Grand Canal burst their banks, the emperor ordered Shu Lin to assist Governor-General Li Shijie of the Two Jiangs, who was inexperienced in hydraulic engineering.

sentences.zh: 與世傑及河督李奉翰議，漫口有四，惟司家莊、湯家莊兩處分溜，急興工堵築；

translations.literal: Together with Li Shijie and the canal director Li Fenghan he deliberated: there were four breach points, but only at Sijiazhuang and Tangjiazhuang should diversion be made, and work to block and build should be urgently undertaken;
translations.idiomatic: With Li Shijie and Canal Director Li Fenghan he decided that of the four breach points, only Sijiazhuang and Tangjiazhuang should be used for diversion, and that blocking and repair work there must begin at once.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「桃源境內河流因順黃壩生有淤灘，水勢紆折不暢。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Within Taoyuan the river, because of silt banks formed along the Yellow River alignment, had a winding course and sluggish flow.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported: "Within Taoyuan, silt bars along the Yellow River alignment had choked the channel and slowed the current.

sentences.zh: 於玉皇閣下挑引河，俾黃流東注會清，以資宣洩。」

translations.literal: Below Jade Emperor Pavilion a diversion channel should be cut so that the Yellow current may flow east into the Huai and aid discharge."
translations.idiomatic: A diversion should be cut below Jade Emperor Pavilion so the Yellow current can run east into the Huai and ease the flood."

sentences.zh: 五十二年，擢兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year he was promoted to governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year he was promoted to governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 書麟素行清謹，出巡屬邑，輕騎減從，民不擾累，特詔嘉之。

translations.literal: Shu Lin had always conducted himself with integrity and caution; when touring subordinate districts he used light escort and reduced retinue, the people were not harassed or burdened, and he received a special imperial commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Lin was known for integrity and restraint. On tours of his districts he traveled light with a small escort, sparing the people trouble, and received a special imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 和珅柄政，書麟與之忤。

translations.literal: When Heshen held power, Shu Lin was at odds with him.
translations.idiomatic: When Heshen dominated the government, Shu Lin stood at odds with him.

sentences.zh: 未幾，有高郵巡檢陳倚道揭報書吏假印重徵事，遣重臣鞫實，坐書麟瞻徇，下部嚴議；

translations.literal: Before long, Gaoyou sub-prefectural inspector Chen Yidao exposed a case of clerks using forged seals to levy extra taxes; a high minister was sent to investigate, and Shu Lin was found guilty of shielding and favoritism, the case referred for severe deliberation;
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Gaoyou inspector Chen Yidao exposed clerks who had used forged seals to levy extra taxes. The emperor sent a senior official to investigate; Shu Lin was found guilty of shielding the culprits and the case was referred for severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 又失察句容書吏侵用錢糧，褫職，遣戍伊犁。

translations.literal: He had also failed to detect Jurong clerks' embezzlement of tax funds; he was stripped of office and sent into exile at Yili.
translations.idiomatic: He was also stripped of office for failing to detect Jurong clerks' embezzlement of tax funds and was exiled to Yili.

sentences.zh: 尋起為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was recalled and made governor of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled and appointed governor of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 內閣學士尹壯圖論州縣虧空由於派累，疆臣中惟李世傑、書麟獨善其身，和珅尤忌之，命壯圖赴各省清查倉庫，自山西始，壯圖因獲譴。

translations.literal: Cabinet academician Yin Zhuangtu argued that prefectural and county deficits arose from levied exactions; among frontier officials only Li Shijie and Shu Lin kept themselves clean, and Heshen especially resented them; he ordered Zhuangtu to go to each province to audit granaries, beginning with Shanxi, and Zhuangtu was punished as a result.
translations.idiomatic: Cabinet Academician Yin Zhuangtu argued that local deficits came from excessive levies. Among frontier governors only Li Shijie and Shu Lin had kept their hands clean, which Heshen especially resented. Heshen sent Zhuangtu to audit provincial granaries, starting in Shanxi, and Zhuangtu himself was punished in the affair.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，仍授兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year he was again appointed governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year he was again appointed governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 兩淮鹽政巴寧阿交結商人，坐書麟徇庇，复奪職，予三等侍衛，赴新疆效力。

translations.literal: Lianghuai salt controller Ba Ning'a colluded with merchants; Shu Lin was found guilty of shielding him, again lost his post, was given the rank of third-class bodyguard, and sent to Xinjiang to redeem himself through service.
translations.idiomatic: Lianghuai salt controller Ba Ning'a had colluded with merchants. Shu Lin was again dismissed for shielding him, given the rank of third-class bodyguard, and sent to Xinjiang to redeem himself through service.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，和珅敗，召授吏部尚書，兼正紅旗漢軍都統，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, when Heshen fell, he was summoned and appointed minister of Personnel, concurrently commander of the Plain Red Banner Han Army, with the added title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4, after Heshen's fall, he was recalled as minister of Personnel, made commander of the Plain Red Banner Han Army, and granted the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 尋協辦大學士，授閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he became associate grand secretary and was appointed governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became associate grand secretary and governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 弟廣興，以首發和珅姦擢官，既得官，多所彈擊，書麟不善所為，嘗於帝前言之。

translations.literal: His younger brother Guangxing, for being first to expose Heshen's crimes, was promoted; once in office he impeached many people. Shu Lin disapproved of his conduct and had spoken of it before the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Guangxing had risen for exposing Heshen's crimes first, but once in office he impeached many officials. Shu Lin disapproved and had told the emperor so.

sentences.zh: 至是，廣興以掌四川軍需獲咎，書麟請嚴治，且自引罪，詔宥之。

translations.literal: At this time Guangxing was punished for managing Sichuan military supplies; Shu Lin asked that he be severely dealt with and took blame upon himself, but an edict pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangxing was punished for mismanaging Sichuan military supplies, Shu Lin asked that he be dealt with severely and accepted blame himself, but the emperor pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 調雲貴，鞫前督富綱，得其貪婪狀，論如律；

translations.literal: Transferred to Yunnan-Guizhou, he tried former governor Fu Gang, obtained proof of his greed, and sentenced him according to law;
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Yunnan-Guizhou, he tried former governor Fu Gang, proved his corruption, and sentenced him under the law.

sentences.zh: 又按問雲南巡撫江蘭諱災，得實，褫江蘭職。

translations.literal: He also investigated Yunnan governor Jiang Lan for concealing disasters; the facts were established and Jiang Lan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He also investigated Yunnan Governor Jiang Lan for concealing disasters, proved the charge, and dismissed him.

sentences.zh: 時倮夷不靖，疏陳江蘭所奏不實，辦理草率，帝嘉其公正。

translations.literal: At the time the Luo tribes were unsettled; he memorialized that Jiang Lan's reports were untrue and his handling careless, and the emperor praised his fairness.
translations.idiomatic: With the Luo tribes in unrest, he reported that Jiang Lan's accounts were false and his handling slipshod. The emperor praised his fairness.

sentences.zh: 遂親赴黃草壩督兵分路進剿，擒賊首李文明等，遣降倮入箐招諭，曉以利害，夷眾五十二寨悔罪輸誠；

translations.literal: He then went in person to Huangcaoba to direct troops advancing by separate routes to suppress the rebels, captured bandit leaders including Li Wenming, sent surrendered Luo into the ravines to summon and instruct them, explained advantage and harm, and fifty-two Yi stockades repented and submitted;
translations.idiomatic: He went in person to Huangcaoba to direct a multi-pronged campaign, captured leaders such as Li Wenming, and sent surrendered Luo into the hills to explain the stakes. Fifty-two Yi stockades repented and submitted.

sentences.zh: 以土司苛派擾夷，立牌申禁：優詔褒賚，加太子太保。

translations.literal: Because native chiefs' harsh levies disturbed the tribes, he erected placards forbidding them: he received an excellent edict of praise and reward and was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He posted notices forbidding native chiefs' harsh levies on the tribes. The emperor praised him lavishly and made him Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 五年，調湖廣，督師剿襄陽青、藍、黃三號教匪。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Huguang to command troops suppressing the Qing, Lan, and Huang sect rebel bands at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to Huguang to command the suppression of the Qing, Lan, and Huang White Lotus bands at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 會長齡等已敗賊瓦房口，書麟以東川、保豐為糧運要路，親往截剿。

translations.literal: Chang Ling and others had already defeated the rebels at Wafangkou; Shu Lin, because Dongchuan and Baofeng were vital supply routes, went in person to intercept and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: After Chang Ling and others had defeated the rebels at Wafangkou, Shu Lin went in person to Dongchuan and Baofeng, key supply routes, to cut off and attack the enemy.

sentences.zh: 帝念其年逾七旬，奔馳山谷間，賊情詭詐，戒毋冒險輕試。

translations.literal: The emperor, mindful that he was over seventy and rushing through mountain valleys while rebel tactics were treacherous, admonished him not to take risks lightly.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful that he was over seventy, racing through mountain valleys against treacherous rebels, the emperor warned him not to take unnecessary risks.

sentences.zh: 六年，由竹山、房縣進剿徐天德，擒斬甚眾。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, advancing from Zhushan and Fangxian to attack Xu Tiande, he captured and killed a great many.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he advanced from Zhushan and Fangxian against Xu Tiande and killed or captured a great many rebels.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「勦賊之法，以固民心、培民氣為要。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The method of suppressing bandits must above all consolidate popular sentiment and nurture popular morale.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: "The key to suppressing rebels is to secure the people's loyalty and restore their morale.

sentences.zh: 撫輯得宜，賊即是民；

translations.literal: If pacification and settlement are properly done, bandits are the people;
translations.idiomatic: Treat them well and rebels become ordinary people again;

sentences.zh: 任其失所，民即是賊。」

translations.literal: if they are allowed to lose their homes, the people become bandits."
translations.idiomatic: leave them homeless and ordinary people become rebels."

sentences.zh: 帝俞之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 川匪苟文明等由陝西平利越老林圖竄房縣，偕長齡、明亮進擊，遇賊獅子崖，大敗之；

translations.literal: Sichuan rebels Gou Wenming and others crossed from Pingli in Shaanxi over the old forest routes intending to flee into Fangxian; together with Chang Ling and Mingliang he advanced to attack, met the rebels at Shiziya, and inflicted a great defeat;
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan rebels led by Gou Wenming crossed from Shaanxi's Pingli through the old forest trails toward Fangxian. With Chang Ling and Mingliang he attacked them at Shiziya and won a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 復分兵伏佘家溝、高尖山，天德等來襲，卻之。

translations.literal: He again divided troops to ambush at Shejiagou and Gaojianshan; Tiande and others came to attack and were repelled.
translations.idiomatic: He then set ambushes at Shejiagou and Gaojianshan and repelled an attack by Tiande and his followers.

sentences.zh: 疏請於襄陽添設提督，移協鎮於鄖陽、竹山二處。

translations.literal: He memorialized asking that a provincial military commander be added at Xiangyang and that regional commanders be moved to Yunyang and Zhushan.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to establish a provincial military command at Xiangyang and to station regional commanders at Yunyang and Zhushan.

sentences.zh: 天德等屯聚茅倫山，令孫清元等分隊破之。

translations.literal: Tiande and others gathered at Maolunshan; he ordered Sun Qingyuan and others to break them up in separate detachments.
translations.idiomatic: When Tiande and his men gathered at Maolunshan, he ordered Sun Qingyuan and others to break them up in separate attacks.

sentences.zh: 因病乞解職，遣侍衛率御醫馳視。

translations.literal: Ill, he begged to be relieved of duty; the emperor sent a bodyguard leading an imperial physician posthaste to examine him.
translations.idiomatic: When illness forced him to ask for relief, the emperor sent a bodyguard with an imperial physician to attend him at once.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒於軍，帝深惜之，贈太子太傅，封一等男爵，以子吉郎阿嗣，諡文勤。

translations.literal: Before long he died in camp; the emperor deeply regretted it, posthumously made him Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, enfeoffed him as a first-class baron, with his son Jilang'a succeeding, posthumous name Wengqin.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died in the field. The emperor mourned him deeply, posthumously made him Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and first-class baron, with his son Jilang'a as heir, and gave him the posthumous name Wengqin, "Cultivated and Diligent."

sentences.zh: 尋以倭什布治餉遲誤，詔斥書麟知而不舉，念其清廉公正，治軍成勞，奠醊恩禮仍有加焉。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward, because Wo-shi-bu had delayed provisioning, an edict rebuked Shu Lin for knowing and not reporting; yet remembering his integrity and fairness and his established merit in commanding troops, the rites of libation still received added favor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Wo-shi-bu's delay in provisioning drew an edict rebuking Shu Lin for knowing and failing to report it. Still, remembering his integrity and his achievements in command, the emperor added honors to the libation rites.

sentences.zh: 弟廣厚，乾隆四十三年進士。

translations.literal: His younger brother Guanghou passed the metropolitan examination in the forty-third year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Guanghou became a jinshi in Qianlong 43.

sentences.zh: 由工部主事歷御史，出為江西吉南贛寧道，遷甘肅按察使。

translations.literal: From a principal clerk in the Ministry of Works he rose through censor, went out as Jiangxi Jianan-Ganning circuit intendant, and was transferred to Gansu provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from a clerk in the Ministry of Works to censor, then served as Jiangxi's Jianan-Ganning circuit intendant and became Gansu surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，偕總兵吉蘭泰擊教匪張映祥、楊天柱於鞏昌、秦州，進蹙諸白水江，殲焉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiaqing, together with regional commander Jilantai he attacked sect rebels Zhang Yingxiang and Yang Tianzhu at Gongchang and Qinzhou, advanced to press them at the Bailong River, and annihilated them.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiaqing he and Regional Commander Jilantai defeated sect rebels Zhang Yingxiang and Yang Tianzhu at Gongchang and Qinzhou, drove them to the Bailong River, and destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 遷江西布政使，調甘肅。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Jiangxi provincial treasurer, then to Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He became Jiangxi provincial treasurer and was then transferred back to Gansu.

sentences.zh: 賊出沒於岷州、禮縣間，廣厚督兵由岷州遮羊鋪遏其衝，保完善之地，境內乂安。

translations.literal: Rebels appeared and vanished between Minzhou and Lixian; Guanghou directed troops from Minzhou to block them at Zheyangpu, protected intact districts, and peace was restored within the jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels raided between Minzhou and Lixian, Guanghou blocked them at Zheyangpu from Minzhou, held the secure districts, and restored peace in the province.

sentences.zh: 調廣東，坐與總督那彥成遊宴，解職，予三等侍衛，為庫車辦事大臣，調哈喇沙爾。

translations.literal: Transferred to Guangdong, he was dismissed for banqueting with Governor-General Nayancheng, given the rank of third-class bodyguard, made Kuche frontier commissioner, and transferred to Karashahr.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Guangdong, he was dismissed for banqueting with Governor-General Nayancheng, given the rank of third-class bodyguard, made frontier commissioner at Kuche, and later transferred to Karashahr.

sentences.zh: 官至安徽、湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: He reached the posts of governor of Anhui and Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He eventually served as governor of Anhui and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 覺羅吉慶，隸正白旗。

translations.literal: Jueluo Jiqing belonged to the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Jueluo Jiqing belonged to the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 父萬福，騎都尉，官江寧將軍，兼散秩大臣。

translations.literal: His father Wanfu held the rank of commandant of cavalry, served as Jiangning general, and was concurrently a minister without regular portfolio.
translations.idiomatic: His father Wanfu was a commandant of cavalry who served as Jiangning general and as a minister without regular portfolio.

sentences.zh: 吉慶由官學生補內閣中書，遷侍讀，歷御史。

translations.literal: Jiqing, from the Imperial Clan School, was appointed a middle secretary in the Grand Secretariat, was promoted to reader, and served as censor.
translations.idiomatic: Jiqing entered service from the Imperial Clan School as a Grand Secretariat secretary, became a reader, and served as censor.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十年，嗣世職。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year of Qianlong he inherited the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 50 he inherited his family's hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 擢鑲白旗蒙古副都統，累遷兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice commander of the Bordered White Mongol Banner and rose repeatedly to vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice commander of the Bordered White Mongol Banner and eventually became vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 命赴山東、湖南、湖北、河南讞獄，均稱旨，調戶部。

translations.literal: Ordered to go to Shandong, Hunan, Hubei, and Henan to try criminal cases, in each case he met with imperial approval and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Sent to try criminal cases in Shandong, Hunan, Hubei, and Henan, he pleased the emperor in each province and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，出為山東巡撫，歲祲，截留漕米三十萬石，撥豫、東軍船運米賑饑。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year he went out as governor of Shandong; the year was famine-stricken, and he retained three hundred thousand piculs of transport grain and allocated military grain boats from Henan and Shandong to carry rice for famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year he became governor of Shandong. During famine he retained 300,000 piculs of transport grain and used military grain boats from Henan and Shandong to ship rice for relief.

sentences.zh: 調浙江，閩海漁船赴浙洋剽掠，吉慶於島嶴編保甲，禁米出洋，嚴緝代賣盜贓；

translations.literal: Transferred to Zhejiang, when Fujian fishing boats came to Zhejiang waters to plunder, Jiqing organized baojia on the islands, forbade rice to be taken out to sea, and strictly pursued those who sold stolen goods on others' behalf;
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Zhejiang, he found Fujian fishing boats raiding Zhejiang waters. He organized baojia on the islands, banned grain exports to sea, and cracked down on fencing stolen goods.

sentences.zh: 兼署提督，獲海盜陳言等，及臨海邪匪李鶴皋，置之法。

translations.literal: Acting concurrently as provincial military commander, he captured pirates including Chen Yan and the heterodox bandit Li Hegao of Linhai, and punished them by law.
translations.idiomatic: As acting provincial military commander he captured pirates including Chen Yan and the sect rebel Li Hegao of Linhai and executed them.

sentences.zh: 鹽政岳謙執拗病民，劾罷之，遂兼鹽政。

translations.literal: Salt controller Yue Qian was obstinate and harmed the people; he impeached and removed him, then concurrently held the salt post.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached and removed Salt Controller Yue Qian for obstinacy that harmed the people, then took over the salt post himself.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，擢兩廣總督，劾水師提督路超吉不勝任，貶超吉秩。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was promoted to governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi, impeached naval commander Lu Chaoji as incompetent, and reduced Chaoji's rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he became governor-general of the Two Guangs, impeached Naval Commander Lu Chaoji as incompetent, and reduced his rank.

sentences.zh: 二年，廣西西隆亞稿寨苗匪句結貴州仲苗，竄踞八渡，率提督彭承堯進剿，克其要隘。

translations.literal: In the second year, Miao bandits of Yagao stockade in Xilong, Guangxi, colluded with Zhong Miao of Guizhou, fled to occupy Badu, and he led Provincial Commander Peng Chengyao forward to suppress them and captured their strategic passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Miao rebels from Yagao stockade in Guangxi's Xilong colluded with Guizhou's Zhong Miao, seized Badu, and he led Provincial Commander Peng Chengyao to take their key passes.

sentences.zh: 黔苗潛渡百樂窺泗城，令副將德昌等分路攻撲，毀苗砦十有九；

translations.literal: Guizhou Miao secretly crossed at Baile intending to spy on Sicheng; he ordered vice commanders including Dechang to attack by separate routes and destroyed nineteen Miao stockades;
translations.idiomatic: When Guizhou Miao secretly crossed at Baile toward Sicheng, he sent Vice Commander Dechang and others along separate routes and destroyed nineteen Miao stockades.

sentences.zh: 進攻亞稿，至戛雄遇賊，大敗之。

translations.literal: Advancing against Yagao, at Gaxiong he met the rebels and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing on Yagao, he met the rebels at Gaxiong and routed them.

sentences.zh: 永豐、百樂等苗目渡江降，給酒食，令回寨招撫。

translations.literal: Miao chiefs of Yongfeng, Baile, and others crossed the river to surrender; he gave them food and drink and ordered them back to their stockades to summon and pacify others.
translations.idiomatic: Miao chiefs from Yongfeng, Baile, and elsewhere crossed the river to surrender. He fed them and sent them back to their stockades to win others over.

sentences.zh: 亞稿山路陡峻，選精卒由間道潛襲，克其巢，斬首千級，以功加太子太保，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: The mountain roads of Yagao were steep; he chose elite troops to strike secretly by a bypath, captured their lair, and beheaded a thousand; for this merit he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Yagao's mountain roads were steep. He sent picked troops along a hidden path, took the rebel stronghold, and took a thousand heads. For this he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 亞稿之捷，投誠者十餘寨，惟附近那地、小河、廣平、蒙裡等寨猶恃險抗拒，會雲南兵至，會剿，盡克之。

translations.literal: After the victory at Yagao, more than ten stockades submitted, but nearby Nadu, Xiaohe, Guangping, Mengli, and other stockades still relied on terrain to resist; when Yunnan troops arrived they joined in suppression and captured them all.
translations.idiomatic: After the victory at Yagao more than ten stockades submitted, but Nadu, Xiaohe, Guangping, Mengli, and nearby stockades still held out. Yunnan troops arrived, they joined the campaign, and took them all.

sentences.zh: 賊首龍登連父子乞降，粵境悉平。

translations.literal: Bandit leaders Long Denglian, father and son, begged to surrender, and the Guangdong border was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel leaders Long Denglian and his son surrendered, and the Guangdong frontier was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 六年，命協辦大學士、總督如故。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was ordered to serve as associate grand secretary while remaining governor as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made associate grand secretary while retaining the governorship.

sentences.zh: 吉慶居官廉而察吏疏，博羅縣重犯越獄，司府徇隱；

translations.literal: Jiqing in office was incorrupt but lax in supervising subordinates; a serious criminal in Boluo county escaped prison, and prefectural officials shielded the matter;
translations.idiomatic: Jiqing was honest in office but lax in supervising subordinates. A serious criminal escaped jail in Boluo county, and prefectural officials covered it up.

sentences.zh: 又通省贓罰銀按縣派徵，為臬司漏規。

translations.literal: furthermore, throughout the province fines in silver were levied by county apportionment as a leak in regulations for the provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial fines in silver were also apportioned by county as an illegal levy for the surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 事並上聞，詔斥其因循。

translations.literal: When both matters were reported upward, an edict rebuked his indulgence and delay.
translations.idiomatic: When both matters reached the throne, an edict rebuked his indulgence and delay.

sentences.zh: 陳爛屐四者，於博羅山中糾眾為添弟會，知府伊秉綬請發兵往捕，吉慶為提督孫全謀所蔽，未許。

translations.literal: Chen Lanxisi, in the Boluo mountains, gathered a crowd into the Tiandihui; prefect Yi Bingshou asked to send troops to capture him, but Jiqing, misled by Provincial Commander Sun Quanmou, did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Lanxisi had gathered a Tiandihui band in the Boluo hills. Prefect Yi Bingshou asked to send troops, but Jiqing, misled by Provincial Commander Sun Quanmou, refused.

sentences.zh: 七年，陳爛屐四果剽掠作亂，擾及數縣，遣師擒斬之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Chen Lanxisi indeed plundered and rebelled, disturbing several counties; troops were sent and he was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Chen Lanxisi did raid and rebel, troubling several counties. Jiqing sent troops who captured and executed him.

sentences.zh: 餘黨曾鬼六复勾結永安諸賊相繼起，吉慶馳往剿捕，請調江西兵二千為助。

translations.literal: Remnant follower Zeng Guiliu again colluded with various bandits of Yong'an, who rose in succession; Jiqing rushed to suppress them and asked that two thousand Jiangxi troops be transferred to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Remnant leader Zeng Guiliu then joined Yong'an bandits in a new uprising. Jiqing rushed to suppress them and asked for two thousand troops from Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 詔斥其張皇，始疑之。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked his alarmism, and the emperor began to doubt him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked his alarmism, and the emperor began to doubt him.

sentences.zh: 尋敗賊於義容墟，曾清浩率眾四千餘人繳械降。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he defeated the bandits at Yirongxu; Zeng Qinghao led more than four thousand men to surrender their weapons.
translations.idiomatic: He soon defeated the rebels at Yirongxu, and Zeng Qinghao surrendered with more than four thousand men and their arms.

sentences.zh: 全謀擒賊渠薛文勝，暨匪眾四百餘，悉誅之。

translations.literal: Quanmou captured bandit chieftain Xue Wensheng and more than four hundred rebel followers, all of whom were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Quanmou captured rebel leader Xue Wensheng and more than four hundred followers and executed them all.

sentences.zh: 事聞，帝以吉慶奏報前後不符，措置失當，罷協辦大學士，留總督任，命那彥成往按。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor, because Jiqing's memorials before and after did not agree and his arrangements were improper, removed him as associate grand secretary but retained him as governor, and ordered Nayancheng to go investigate.
translations.idiomatic: When the reports arrived, the emperor found Jiqing's accounts inconsistent and his handling inept. He stripped him of the associate grand secretary post but kept him as governor and sent Nayancheng to investigate.

sentences.zh: 吉慶復奏永安降匪多，請留兵防範，詔斥《頁》結局，解任聽勘。

translations.literal: Jiqing again memorialized that there were many surrendered bandits in Yong'an and asked to retain troops for defense; an edict rebuked his careless conclusion to the affair, relieved him of duty, and ordered him to await investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Jiqing then reported many surrendered bandits in Yong'an and asked to keep troops on guard. The emperor rebuked him for trying to wrap the affair up carelessly, removed him from office, and ordered him to await trial.

sentences.zh: 巡撫瑚圖禮素與有隙，既奉密諭诇察，遂疏劾其疲輭不職，那彥成猶未至，獨鞫之，據高坐，設囚具，隸卒故加訶辱。

translations.literal: Governor Hutuli had long been at odds with him; having received a secret edict to spy, he memorialized impeaching him as slack and incompetent; before Nayancheng arrived he alone tried him, sat on a high seat, set out prisoner implements, and clerks and runners deliberately added abuse and insult.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Hutuli, who had long been his enemy, received a secret order to investigate and impeached him as slack and incompetent. Before Nayancheng arrived, Hutuli tried him alone from a high seat with shackles set out, while attendants deliberately insulted him.

sentences.zh: 吉慶恚曰：「某雖不肖，曾備位政府，不可受辱傷國體！」

translations.literal: Jiqing angrily said: "Though I am unworthy, I once held office in the central government; I cannot accept insult that wounds the dignity of the state!"
translations.idiomatic: Jiqing said in anger: "I may be unworthy, but I once served in the central government. I cannot endure insult that shames the state!"

sentences.zh: 因自戕。

translations.literal: and thereupon killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: He then took his own life.

sentences.zh: 帝聞，命那彥成陳狀，尋以吉慶素廉潔，治匪有功，無故輕生，詔免追論。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard, he ordered Nayancheng to report the facts; shortly afterward, because Jiqing had always been incorrupt, had merit in suppressing bandits, and had taken his life without cause, an edict exempted further prosecution.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing this, the emperor ordered Nayancheng to report the facts. Remembering Jiqing's integrity and his success against bandits, and that he had killed himself without due cause, the emperor decreed that no further charges be pursued.

sentences.zh: 子壽喜，仍襲世職，坐事黜，以弟常喜嗣。

translations.literal: His son Shouxi still inherited the hereditary office, was dismissed for an offense, and his younger brother Changxi succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shouxi inherited the hereditary office but was dismissed for an offense; his younger brother Changxi succeeded instead.

sentences.zh: 覺羅長麟，字牧庵，隸正藍旗。

translations.literal: Jueluo Zhanglin, style name Mu'an, belonged to the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Jueluo Zhanglin, whose style was Mu'an, belonged to the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十年進士，授刑部主事。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the fortieth year of Qianlong, he was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of Qianlong 40, he was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 貌奇偉，明敏有口辯，居曹有聲。

translations.literal: His appearance was remarkably imposing; he was bright, quick, and skilled in debate, and made a name in his bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was striking in appearance, quick-witted and articulate, and won renown in his bureau.

sentences.zh: 歷郎中，出為福建興泉永道，累遷江蘇布政使。

translations.literal: He rose through director, went out as Fujian Xingquan-Yong circuit intendant, and was promoted repeatedly to Jiangsu provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to director, served as Fujian's Xingquan-Yong circuit intendant, and eventually became Jiangsu provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，召授刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year he was summoned and appointed vice minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year he was recalled to the capital as vice minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，授山東巡撫，責所屬濬河道，修四十一州縣城工；

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year he was appointed governor of Shandong, charged his subordinates with dredging river channels and repairing city works in forty-one prefectures and counties;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year he became governor of Shandong, ordered his subordinates to dredge river channels, and repaired city walls in forty-one prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 捕鉅野、汶上劇盜田玉堂等，置之法：詔嘉獎。

translations.literal: he captured major bandits including Tian Yutang of Juye and Wenshang and punished them by law: an edict praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: He captured major bandits such as Tian Yutang in Juye and Wenshang and executed them, earning an imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 劾萊州知府徐大榕治平度州民羅有良獄，誤擬，大榕訴於京，刑部尚書胡季堂等往鞫，不直長麟。

translations.literal: He impeached Laizhou prefect Xu Darong for handling the case of Pingdu commoner Luo Youliang with a mistaken sentence recommendation; Darong appealed to the capital, and Minister of Punishments Hu Jitang and others went to try the case and found against Zhanglin.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Laizhou Prefect Xu Darong for a mistaken sentence in the case of Luo Youliang of Pingdu. Darong appealed to the capital, and Minister of Punishments Hu Jitang and others investigated and ruled against Zhanglin.

sentences.zh: 帝以防河有勞，特寬之。

translations.literal: The emperor, because of his merit in river defense, specially showed leniency.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor spared him specially for his work on river control.

sentences.zh: 復以審擬濱州舉人薛對元罪失實，褫職，留修城工。

translations.literal: Again, because his review of the guilt of Binzhou licentiate Xue Duiyuan was not factual, he was stripped of office but retained to repair city works.
translations.idiomatic: He was again stripped of office when his finding in the case of Binzhou licentiate Xue Duiyuan proved wrong, but was kept on to finish the city repairs.

sentences.zh: 未幾，授江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed governor of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 嘗私行市井間訪察民隱，擒治強暴，禁革奢俗，清漕政，斥貪吏，為時所稱。

translations.literal: He once went privately into market streets to investigate the people's hidden grievances, seized and punished the violent, forbade and reformed extravagant customs, cleared up grain transport administration, and expelled corrupt officials, and was praised by his contemporaries.
translations.idiomatic: He often went incognito into the markets to learn the people's grievances, punished bullies, banned extravagant customs, cleaned up grain transport, and expelled corrupt officials, winning wide praise.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，調山西。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year he was transferred to Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year he was transferred to Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 入覲時，有市人董二誣告逆匪王倫潛匿山西某家，和申於宮門前言，務坐以逆黨。

translations.literal: When he came to audience, a townsman Dong Er falsely accused rebel Wang Lun of hiding in a certain Shanxi household; Heshen spoke before the palace gate and insisted on convicting them as rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On a capital audience, a townsman named Dong Er falsely accused the rebel Wang Lun of hiding in a Shanxi household. Heshen spoke at the palace gate and insisted they be convicted as rebels.

sentences.zh: 長麟至官，訪悉某實董仇家，​​故傾陷，慨然曰：「吾發垂白，奈何滅人族以媚權相？」

translations.literal: When Zhanglin reached his post, he investigated and learned that the household was in fact Dong's enemy and had been framed; he said with feeling: "My hair is nearly white—how can I destroy a clan to please the powerful minister?"
translations.idiomatic: At his post Zhanglin found the accused family was Dong's enemy, framed out of spite. He said bitterly: "My hair is nearly white. How can I destroy a whole clan to please the chief minister?"

sentences.zh: 終反坐董二，和珅大忤。

translations.literal: In the end Dong Er himself was convicted instead, and Heshen was greatly offended.
translations.idiomatic: In the end Dong Er was convicted instead, and Heshen took great offense.

sentences.zh: 調浙江，擢兩廣總督，加太子少保。

translations.literal: Transferred to Zhejiang, he was promoted to governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi and made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Zhejiang, he was promoted to governor-general of the Two Guangs and made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 整頓水師，擒獲海盜。

translations.literal: He reorganized the navy and captured pirates.
translations.idiomatic: He reorganized the navy and captured pirates.

sentences.zh: 六十年，調署閩浙。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he was transferred to act as governor of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year he was made acting governor of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 會將軍魁倫劾總督伍拉納、巡撫浦霖貪縱，並閩省庫藏虧絀事，命長麟按治，未得實，詔切責，乃奏婪索納賄狀。

translations.literal: When General Kuilun impeached Governor-General Wulana and Governor Pulin for greed and indulgence, together with deficits in Fujian's treasury stores, Zhanglin was ordered to investigate; at first the facts were not established and he was sharply rebuked by edict, whereupon he memorialized the facts of extortion and bribe-taking.
translations.idiomatic: When General Kuilun impeached Governor-General Wulana and Governor Pulin for corruption and for deficits in the Fujian treasury, Zhanglin was ordered to investigate. At first he found nothing and was sharply rebuked, but he then memorialized proof of extortion and bribery.

sentences.zh: 伍拉納故和珅姻戚，帝疑長麟瞻徇，並斥其平日沽名取巧，奪職，予副都統銜，赴葉爾羌辦事。

translations.literal: Wulana was formerly a relative by marriage of Heshen; the emperor suspected Zhanglin of shielding him, also rebuked his usual reputation-seeking and trickery, stripped him of office, gave him the rank of vice commander-in-chief, and sent him to Yarkand on frontier duty.
translations.idiomatic: Wulana was related to Heshen by marriage. The emperor suspected Zhanglin of shielding him, rebuked his reputation-seeking ways, stripped him of office, gave him vice commander rank, and sent him to Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 尋授庫爾喀拉烏蘇領隊大臣，調喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed lead commander at Kurkara Usu and transferred to Kashgar as participating commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became lead commander at Kurkara Usu and was transferred to Kashgar as participating commissioner.

sentences.zh: 奏減回子王公年班進京行李，以卹驛站。

translations.literal: He memorialized to reduce the baggage of Muslim princes and nobles on their annual missions to the capital, to spare the courier stations.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to reduce the baggage allowed Muslim princes on their annual missions to the capital, to spare the courier stations.

sentences.zh: 罷回民土貢。

translations.literal: He abolished local tribute from Muslim commoners.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished local tribute levied on Muslim commoners.

sentences.zh: 有邊警，請調兵堵剿，詔以張皇斥之。

translations.literal: When there was a border alarm he asked to transfer troops to block and suppress it; an edict rebuked his alarmism.
translations.idiomatic: When a border alarm arose he asked for troops to block the enemy, but an edict rebuked his alarmism.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，授雲貴總督，調閩浙。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he was appointed governor-general of Yunnan-Guizhou, then transferred to Fujian-Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 he became governor-general of Yunnan-Guizhou, then was transferred to Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 五年，調陝甘。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 時教匪未靖，勸民築堡團練，令川、陝、豫、楚交界處，一體仿行，募精壯難民入伍。

translations.literal: At the time sect rebels were not yet pacified; he urged the people to build stockades and organize militia, ordered the border regions of Sichuan, Shaanxi, Henan, and Hubei to follow suit uniformly, and recruited able-bodied refugees into the army.
translations.idiomatic: With sect rebels still active, he urged stockades and militia training, ordered the same on the borders of Sichuan, Shaanxi, Henan, and Hubei, and recruited able refugees into the army.

sentences.zh: 督師敗伍金柱於唐家河，又擊於傅家鎮。

translations.literal: Commanding troops he defeated Wu Jinzhu at Tangjiahe and attacked again at Fujiazhen.
translations.idiomatic: In command he defeated Wu Jinzhu at Tangjiahe and fought him again at Fujiazhen.

sentences.zh: 將軍富成來援，戰歿。

translations.literal: General Fucheng came to reinforce and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: General Fucheng came to reinforce him and was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 复偕固原提督慶成擊賊於沔陽乾溝河。

translations.literal: Again, together with Guyuan provincial commander Qingcheng, he attacked the bandits at Qiangou River in Mianyang.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined Guyuan Commander Qingcheng to attack the rebels at Qiangou River in Mianyang.

sentences.zh: 六年，迭敗高天德、馬學禮於鐵爐川、舊州鋪、綱廠、武關，擒襄陽賊首馬應祥，詔嘉獎。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he repeatedly defeated Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli at Tieluchuan, Jiuzhoupu, Gangchang, and Wuguan, captured Xiangyang rebel leader Ma Yingxiang, and received an edict of praise and reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he repeatedly defeated Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli at Tieluchuan, Jiuzhoupu, Gangchang, and Wuguan, captured the Xiangyang rebel leader Ma Yingxiang, and won an imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 尋以副將蕭福祿搜捕汧陽悄悄會匪，濫殺邀功，仁宗疑之，诇察得實，斥長麟徇庇，停​​其議敘。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward, because vice commander Xiao Fulu, while searching for Qianyang Quiet Society bandits, killed indiscriminately to claim merit, the Renzong Emperor was suspicious; investigation established the facts, rebuked Zhanglin for shielding him, and suspended his merit review.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Vice Commander Xiao Fulu, hunting Qianyang Quiet Society rebels, killed indiscriminately to claim credit. The emperor investigated, found Zhanglin had shielded him, and suspended his merit review.

sentences.zh: 又以傅家鎮之戰，漫無籌措，致富成陣亡。

translations.literal: Also, because of the battle at Fujiazhen he had made no plans whatsoever, causing Fucheng's death in formation.
translations.idiomatic: He was also blamed for the battle at Fujiazhen, where his lack of planning had led to Fucheng's death.

sentences.zh: 七年，召回京，降署吏部侍郎，遷禮部尚書，兼都統。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was recalled to the capital, demoted to acting vice minister of Personnel, transferred to minister of Rites, and made concurrent banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was recalled, demoted to acting vice minister of Personnel, made minister of Rites, and given a concurrent banner command.

sentences.zh: 復命督兩廣，以母老留京。

translations.literal: Again ordered to govern the Two Guangs, he remained in the capital because his mother was old.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered again to govern the Two Guangs, he stayed in the capital because his mother was elderly.

sentences.zh: 八年，授兵部尚書，調刑部，兼管戶部三庫。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed minister of War, transferred to Punishments, and concurrently managed the three treasuries of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he became minister of War, moved to Punishments, and concurrently managed the Ministry of Revenue's three treasuries.

sentences.zh: 十年，兼翰林院掌院學士，尋協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was made concurrently chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, and shortly afterward associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he became chancellor of the Hanlin Academy and soon associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命偕尚書戴衢亨察視南河。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered together with Minister Dai Quheng to inspect the Southern Canal.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he and Minister Dai Quheng were ordered to inspect the Southern Canal.

sentences.zh: 長麟至清江浦，聞安徽諸生包世臣習河事，親訪之，同視海口，實不高仰，用其說罷改道之議。

translations.literal: Zhanglin reached Qingjiangpu, heard that Anhui licentiate Bao Shichen was versed in river affairs, visited him in person, together viewed the estuary, found it was in fact not high enough, and adopted his view to abandon the proposal to change the channel.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingjiangpu Zhanglin heard that Anhui licentiate Bao Shichen knew river work. He visited Bao in person, inspected the estuary with him, found it was not high enough, and adopted his advice to drop the plan to change the channel.

sentences.zh: 與衢亨通籌河工，具得要領，帝嘉之。

translations.literal: Together with Quheng he planned river works comprehensively and grasped the essentials; the emperor praised this.
translations.idiomatic: With Quheng he planned the river works thoroughly and won the emperor's praise.

sentences.zh: 复偕衢亨清查兩淮鹽務，責鹽政每年雜費悉報部覈銷，以息浮議。

translations.literal: Again with Quheng he audited Lianghuai salt administration, requiring the salt controller to report all annual miscellaneous expenses to the ministry for verification and cancellation, to quiet loose talk.
translations.idiomatic: With Quheng he also audited Lianghuai salt affairs, requiring all annual miscellaneous expenses to be reported to the ministry for audit, to end loose talk.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以目眚久在告，特詔解職。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, because of chronic eye ailment he had long been on leave; a special edict relieved him of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year chronic eye trouble led to a special edict relieving him of office.

sentences.zh: 逾年，卒，諡文敏。

translations.literal: After a year he died, posthumous name Wenmin.
translations.idiomatic: He died the following year and was given the posthumous name Wenmin, "Cultivated and Quick."

sentences.zh: 費淳，字筠浦，浙江錢塘人。

translations.literal: Fei Chun, style name Yunpu, was a native of Qiantang, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Fei Chun, whose style was Yunpu, was from Qiantang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十八年進士，授刑部主事。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the twenty-eighth year of Qianlong, he was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of Qianlong 28, he was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 歷郎中，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: He rose through director and served as a Grand Council clerk.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to director and served as a Grand Council clerk.

sentences.zh: 出為江蘇常州知府，父憂去。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Changzhou, Jiangsu, then left on his father's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He became prefect of Changzhou in Jiangsu but resigned when his father died.

sentences.zh: 服闋，補山西太原，擢冀寧道。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was assigned to Taiyuan, Shanxi, and was promoted to Jining circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning he was posted to Taiyuan in Shanxi and promoted to Jining circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 累遷雲南布政使，有惠政。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Yunnan provincial treasurer and had benevolent policies.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Yunnan provincial treasurer, where his rule brought real benefit to the people.

sentences.zh: 以母老乞終養，喪除，起故官。

translations.literal: Because his mother was old he begged to retire and care for her until her death; after mourning he was recalled to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to retire to care for his elderly mother. After her death and mourning he returned to office.

sentences.zh: 六十年，擢安徽巡撫，調江蘇。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he was promoted to governor of Anhui, then transferred to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year he became governor of Anhui and was then transferred to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，疏言：「淮、徐、揚三府屬被水窪地，責州縣勸植蘆葦，以收地利。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he memorialized: "In the waterlogged lowlands of the three prefectures Huai, Xu, and Yang, prefectures and counties should be charged to encourage planting reeds to gain land benefit.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he wrote: "In the flooded lowlands of Huai, Xu, and Yang prefectures, local officials should encourage reed planting to make use of the land.

sentences.zh: 應納錢糧，即照蘆課改折徵輸。」

translations.literal: Tax grain due should be collected in converted reed-tax payments instead."
translations.idiomatic: Tax due should be collected as converted reed-tax payments instead."

sentences.zh: 詔議行。

translations.literal: An edict ordered deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the plan adopted.

sentences.zh: 調福建，復還江蘇。

translations.literal: Transferred to Fujian, he then returned to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Fujian and then back to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 四年，擢兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he became governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 淳歷官廉謹，為帝所重，兩淮鹽政徵瑞與淳為姻家，免其迴避。

translations.literal: Chun throughout his career was incorrupt and cautious and was valued by the emperor; Lianghuai salt controller Zhengrui was related to Chun by marriage, and he was exempted from the avoidance rule.
translations.idiomatic: Chun was known for integrity and caution and was highly regarded by the emperor. Lianghuai Salt Controller Zhengrui was his in-law, so he was exempted from the conflict-of-interest rule.

sentences.zh: 時南河比歲漫溢，淳以江督事繁，自陳未諳河務，乞免兼管，允之。

translations.literal: At the time the Southern Canal overflowed year after year; Chun, because the Jiangsu governor's duties were numerous, stated himself that he was not versed in river affairs and begged to be excused from concurrent management, which was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Canal had overflowed several years running. Chun said the governor's duties were too heavy and that he did not know river work, and asked to be excused from managing it. The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 命淳與總河詳議河務工程，應行分辦事具聞，帝密詢漕督蔣兆奎等優劣，諭曰：「安民首在任賢，除弊必先去貪。

translations.literal: He was ordered together with the canal director to deliberate in detail on river projects and report what should be undertaken in separate assignments; the emperor secretly inquired about the merits of Grain Transport Director Jiang Zhaokui and others, instructing: "To settle the people, appointing the worthy comes first; to remove abuses, expelling the greedy is essential.
translations.idiomatic: He and the canal director were ordered to plan river works in detail. The emperor secretly asked about Grain Transport Director Jiang Zhaokui and others, and instructed him: "To secure the people you must appoint the worthy; to remove abuses you must drive out the greedy.

sentences.zh: 汝操守雖優，察吏過寬。

translations.literal: Though your integrity is excellent, you are too lenient in supervising officials.
translations.idiomatic: Your integrity is excellent, but you are too lenient in supervising officials.

sentences.zh: 去一貪吏，萬姓蒙福；

translations.literal: Remove one corrupt official and ten thousand families receive blessing;
translations.idiomatic: Remove one corrupt official and ten thousand families benefit;

sentences.zh: 進一賢臣，一方受惠。

translations.literal: advance one worthy minister and a whole region receives benefit.
translations.idiomatic: advance one worthy minister and a whole region is helped.

sentences.zh: 其悉心訪聞，慎勿迎合朕意，顛倒是非。」

translations.literal: Investigate diligently and take care not to cater to my wishes and invert right and wrong."
translations.idiomatic: Investigate carefully and do not cater to my wishes or invert right and wrong."

sentences.zh: 淳具以實聞。

translations.literal: Chun reported everything in full according to fact.
translations.idiomatic: Chun reported everything frankly and in full.

sentences.zh: 有匿名訐告常州知府胡觀瀾者，下淳按治，疏糾觀瀾與江陰知縣楊世綬勒派累民，得實，請嚴譴。

translations.literal: There was an anonymous accusation against Changzhou prefect Hu Guanlan; the case was sent to Chun for investigation; he memorialized impeaching Guanlan and Jiangyin magistrate Yang Shishou for forced levies burdening the people; the facts were established and he asked for severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An anonymous complaint accused Changzhou Prefect Hu Guanlan. Chun investigated and impeached Guanlan and Jiangyin Magistrate Yang Shishou for forced levies that burdened the people. The charges were proved and he asked for severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 詔斥不先劾，以平日廉潔，覆奏無徇隱，寬之。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked him for not impeaching earlier; because of his usual integrity, his follow-up memorial stating there was no shielding was accepted and he was shown leniency.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked him for not acting sooner, but spared him because of his usual integrity and because his follow-up report showed no concealment.

sentences.zh: 尋劾鹽巡道彭翼蒙奢侈糜費，褫翼蒙職。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he impeached salt patrol intendant Peng Yimeng for luxury and wasteful spending and stripped Yimeng of office.
translations.idiomatic: He soon impeached Salt Patrol Intendant Peng Yimeng for luxury and waste and stripped him of office.

sentences.zh: 复劾漕運總督富綱私受衛弁餽銀，時富綱已調雲貴總督，命吉慶嚴鞫，置諸法。

translations.literal: Again he impeached Grain Transport Director Fu Gang for privately receiving silver gifts from transport guards; at the time Fu Gang had already been transferred to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Jiqing was ordered to try him strictly and punish him by law.
translations.idiomatic: He also impeached Grain Transport Director Fu Gang for taking bribes from transport guards. Fu Gang had already become Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Jiqing was ordered to try him strictly and punish him under the law.

sentences.zh: 漕運旗丁苦累，屢議加徵調劑，偕漕督鐵保疏陳：「原徵隨漕項下有款可撥，以裨運丁；

translations.literal: Transport banner soldiers suffered hardship; repeated proposals were made to add levies for relief; together with Transport Director Tie Bao he memorialized: "Under the original transport tax items there are funds that can be allocated to aid the transport soldiers;
translations.idiomatic: Transport banner soldiers were overburdened and repeated proposals called for extra levies. With Transport Director Tie Bao he wrote: "Funds already collected under transport tax items can be allocated to aid the transport soldiers;

sentences.zh: 又旗丁月米，令州縣改給折色，應領運費，責糧道放給，以免層層剝削。」

translations.literal: furthermore, for banner soldiers' monthly grain, let prefectures and counties pay in commuted silver; transport fees due should be issued by the grain intendant, to avoid layer upon layer of exaction."
translations.idiomatic: banner soldiers' monthly grain rations should be paid in commuted silver by local officials, and transport fees should be issued by the grain intendant to stop layer upon layer of exaction."

sentences.zh: 如所請行。

translations.literal: As requested, it was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was adopted as requested.

sentences.zh: 五年，邵家壩河工合龍，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Shaojiaba river works were joined; he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Shaojiaba river works were completed and he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 六年，以足疾乞歸醫治，允之，命毋解職。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, because of foot ailment he begged to return home for medical treatment; this was granted, and he was ordered not to resign his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he asked to go home to treat a foot ailment. The request was granted but he was told to keep his post.

sentences.zh: 尋稱足疾已瘳，若遵旨回籍，轉涉欺矇，詔嘉其得大臣體，賜內府藥餌。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he said his foot ailment had healed; if he obeyed the order to return to his native place it would involve deception; an edict praised his grasp of a minister's integrity and bestowed palace medicines.
translations.idiomatic: He soon said his foot had healed and that returning home as ordered would be deceptive. The emperor praised his sense of ministerial duty and sent him medicines from the imperial pharmacy.

sentences.zh: 七年，宿州土匪王潮名糾眾戕官，檄鎮將剿捕。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Suzhou bandit Wang Chaoming gathered a crowd and killed officials; he ordered the garrison commander to suppress and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the bandit Wang Chaoming of Suzhou gathered followers and killed officials. Chun ordered the garrison commander to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 事定，請於宿之南平集設撫民同知，裁寧國府同知，移駐其地，並調設營汛，從之。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, he asked to establish a pacification sub-prefect at Nanpingji in Suzhou, abolish the Tongzhi of Ningguo prefecture, move the post there, and also transfer and establish garrison posts; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: After order was restored he asked to establish a pacification sub-prefect at Nanpingji in Suzhou, abolish the Ningguo sub-prefect post and move it there, and set up garrison posts. The plan was approved.

sentences.zh: 八年，召授兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was summoned and appointed minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was recalled as minister of War.

sentences.zh: 時河決河南衡家樓，橫溢張秋以南，由鹽河入海，有妨漕運，命淳往勘治，於張秋西岸加寬裹頭，東岸加高長堤，以防溜勢北掣，南口趁汶水北注之勢，引歸河身；

translations.literal: At the time the river burst at Hengjialou in Henan, spread south of Zhangqiu, entered the sea by the salt canal, and hindered grain transport; Chun was ordered to go survey and repair; on the west bank at Zhangqiu he widened the head wrapping, on the east bank raised the long dike, to guard against the current's northward pull; at the south mouth he took advantage of the Wen River's northward flow to lead it back into the main channel;
translations.idiomatic: When the river broke at Hengjialou in Henan and flooded south of Zhangqiu into the salt canal, threatening grain transport, Chun was sent to survey and repair it. He widened the west bank revetment at Zhangqiu, raised the east bank dike to check the current's northward pull, and at the south mouth used the Wen River's flow to return water to the main channel.

sentences.zh: 北口自大溜迤北，分導餘流，以資挽運：並仿南河刷沙法，制混江龍鐵篦船以疏淤。

translations.literal: at the north mouth from the main current northward he divided and guided surplus flow to aid hauling: and imitating the Southern Canal sand-flushing method, he devised iron-rake "River Dragon" boats to dredge silt.
translations.idiomatic: At the north mouth he diverted surplus flow northward to aid hauling, and following Southern Canal practice built iron-rake "River Dragon" dredging boats to clear silt.

sentences.zh: 明年，糧運過張秋無阻，降詔褒賚。

translations.literal: The next year grain transport passed Zhangqiu without obstruction, and an edict praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: The next year grain transport passed Zhangqiu without hindrance, and he received an imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 調吏部尚書、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: He was transferred to minister of Personnel and associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was made minister of Personnel and associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 十一年，偕尚書長麟按問直隸籓司書吏侵冒錢糧​​獄，鞫實，論如律。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, together with Minister Zhanglin he investigated the case of Zhili provincial treasurer clerks' embezzlement of tax funds; the facts were established and they sentenced according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he and Minister Zhanglin investigated Zhili treasurer clerks' embezzlement of tax funds, proved the case, and sentenced them under the law.

sentences.zh: 十二年，拜體仁閣大學士，管理工部，兼管戶部三庫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was appointed grand secretary of the Hall of Embodied Benevolence, managed the Ministry of Works, and concurrently managed the three treasuries of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he became grand secretary of the Hall of Embodied Benevolence, headed the Ministry of Works, and concurrently managed the Revenue treasuries.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以庫銀被竊，鐫秩留任。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, because treasury silver was stolen, his rank was inscribed and he was retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year treasury silver was stolen and his rank was reduced, but he kept his post.

sentences.zh: 已，复坐失察工部書吏冒領三庫銀，詔切責，削宮銜，左遷侍郎，調兵部。

translations.literal: Afterward he was again found guilty of failing to detect Works Ministry clerks' fraudulent receipt of silver from the three treasuries; an edict sharply rebuked him, stripped his palace rank, demoted him to vice minister, and transferred him to War.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was again blamed for failing to detect Works Ministry clerks' fraudulent draws on the three treasuries. An edict sharply rebuked him, stripped his palace rank, demoted him to vice minister, and transferred him to War.

sentences.zh: 逾年，复授工部尚書。

translations.literal: After a year he was again appointed minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he was again made minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒，復大學士，諡文恪，祀雲南名宦。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died; his grand secretary rank was restored, posthumous name Wenk'e, and he was enshrined among Yunnan's notable officials.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixteenth year. His grand secretary rank was restored, he received the posthumous name Wenk'e, "Cultivated and Respectful," and was enshrined among Yunnan's notable officials.

sentences.zh: 百齡，字菊溪，張氏，漢軍正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Bai Ling, style name Juxi, of the Zhang clan, was a Han Bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Ling, whose style was Juxi, belonged to the Zhang clan and the Han Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong, he was selected as a Hanlin bachelor and appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of Qianlong 37, he became a Hanlin bachelor and then a compiler.

sentences.zh: 掌院阿桂重之，曰：「公輔器也！」

translations.literal: Chancellor Agui valued him and said: "Material for chief minister!"
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Agui valued him and said: "Here is material for chief minister!"

sentences.zh: 督山西學政，改御史，歷奉天、順天府丞。

translations.literal: He supervised Shanxi education, was changed to censor, and served as vice prefect of Fengtian and Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised education in Shanxi, became a censor, and served as vice prefect of Fengtian and Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 百齡負才自守，不干進，邅回閒職十餘年。

translations.literal: Bai Ling relied on his talent and kept himself aloof, did not seek advancement, and lingered in idle posts for more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Talented and self-contained, Bai Ling did not seek advancement and spent more than ten years in minor posts.

sentences.zh: 仁宗親政後，始加拔擢。

translations.literal: Only after the Renzong Emperor personally took power was he promoted.
translations.idiomatic: Only after the Renzong Emperor took personal power was he promoted.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶五年，出為湖南按察使，調浙江，歷貴州、雲南布政使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Jiaqing he went out as Hunan surveillance commissioner, was transferred to Zhejiang, and served as Guizhou and Yunnan provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 5 he became Hunan surveillance commissioner, was transferred to Zhejiang, and served as treasurer in Guizhou and Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 八年，擢廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was promoted to governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he became governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 武緣縣有冤獄，諸生黃萬鏐等為知縣孫廷標誣擬大辟，百齡下車，劾廷標逮問，帝嘉之，賜花翎；

translations.literal: In Wuyuan county there was a wrongful case: licentiates Huang Wanliu and others were falsely sentenced to death by magistrate Sun Tingbiao; when Bai Ling took office he impeached Tingbiao and had him arrested for trial; the emperor praised this and bestowed the peacock feather;
translations.idiomatic: In Wuyuan county Licentiates Huang Wanliu and others had been falsely sentenced to death by Magistrate Sun Tingbiao. As soon as Bai Ling took office he impeached Sun and had him arrested. The emperor praised him and granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 洎定讞，特加太子少保。

translations.literal: when the verdict was settled he was specially made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When the case was settled he was specially made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十年，調廣東。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was transferred to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 南海、番禺兩縣蠹役私設班館，羈留無辜，為民害，重懲之；

translations.literal: In Nanhai and Panyu counties corrupt runners privately set up detention houses, held innocent people, and harmed the people; he punished them severely;
translations.idiomatic: In Nanhai and Panyu corrupt runners ran private detention houses that held innocent people. He punished them severely.

sentences.zh: 劾罷縱容之知縣王軾、趙興武，嚴申禁令：詔予優敘。

translations.literal: he impeached and removed the magistrates Wang Shi and Zhao Xingwu who had indulged them, and strictly proclaimed the prohibition: an edict granted him superior merit review.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Magistrates Wang Shi and Zhao Xingwu for tolerating them and strictly enforced the ban. The emperor granted him a superior merit review.

sentences.zh: 尋擢湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was promoted to governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 兩湖多盜，下令擒捕，行以便宜，江、湖晏然。

translations.literal: The Two Hu had many bandits; he ordered capture, acted with discretionary authority, and the rivers and lakes were tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Banditry was rife in the Two Hu. He ordered arrests and acted with full discretionary power until the rivers and lakes were calm again.

sentences.zh: 未幾，王軾訐百齡在粵用非刑斃命，逼勒供應，臨行用運夫二千餘名。

translations.literal: Before long Wang Shi accused Bai Ling of using illegal torture to cause death in Guangdong, of coercing supplies, and of using more than two thousand transport laborers when leaving.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wang Shi accused Bai Ling of using illegal torture to cause deaths in Guangdong, of extorting supplies, and of taking more than two thousand transport laborers when he left.

sentences.zh: 總督那彥成疏劾，並及到湖北後，截留廣東會奏批摺。

translations.literal: Governor-General Nayancheng memorialized impeachment, also citing after reaching Hubei his interception of Guangdong joint memorial rescripts.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Nayancheng impeached him, also charging that after reaching Hubei he had intercepted Guangdong joint memorial rescripts.

sentences.zh: 命吳熊光等按鞫，議褫職遣戍，帝原之，命效力實錄館。

translations.literal: Wu Xiongguang and others were ordered to investigate; they recommended stripping office and exile; the emperor pardoned him and ordered him to serve at the Veritable Records Office.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xiongguang and others were ordered to investigate. They recommended dismissal and exile, but the emperor pardoned him and sent him to serve at the Veritable Records Office.

sentences.zh: 尋予六品頂戴，赴福建治糧餉，事竣，授汀漳龍道。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was given a sixth-rank button, sent to Fujian to manage grain and funds; when the task was done he was appointed Tingzhang-Long circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: He soon received a sixth-rank button, was sent to Fujian to manage grain and funds, and when the task ended became Tingzhang-Long circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 擢湖南按察使，調江蘇，以病歸。

translations.literal: Promoted to Hunan surveillance commissioner, transferred to Jiangsu, he returned home on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to Hunan surveillance commissioner and transferred to Jiangsu, he went home ill.

sentences.zh: 病痊，授鴻臚寺卿，歷山東按察使，就擢巡撫。

translations.literal: When his illness healed he was appointed director of the Court of State Ceremonial, served as Shandong surveillance commissioner, and was then promoted to governor.
translations.idiomatic: After he recovered he became director of the Court of State Ceremonial, served as Shandong surveillance commissioner, and was then promoted to governor.

sentences.zh: 十四年，擢兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he became governor-general of the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 粵洋久不靖，巨寇張保挾眾數万，勢甚張。

translations.literal: The Guangdong seas had long been unsettled; the great bandit Zhang Bao led tens of thousands of followers and his power was very great.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong coast had long been troubled. The great pirate Zhang Bao commanded tens of thousands of men and his power was formidable.

sentences.zh: 百齡至，撤沿海商船，改鹽運由陸，禁銷贓、接濟水米諸弊。

translations.literal: When Bai Ling arrived, he withdrew coastal merchant shipping, changed salt transport to go by land, and forbade the sale of stolen goods and the supplying of water and grain and other abuses.
translations.idiomatic: When Bai Ling arrived he withdrew coastal merchant ships, routed salt transport overland, and banned fencing stolen goods and supplying the pirates with food and water.

sentences.zh: 籌餉練水師，懲貪去懦，水師提督孫全謀失機，劾逮治罪。

translations.literal: He raised funds and trained the navy, punished greed and removed the timid; naval commander Sun Quanmou lost his opportunity and was impeached, arrested, and punished.
translations.idiomatic: He raised funds, trained the navy, punished corruption, and removed the timid. Naval Commander Sun Quanmou missed his chance and was impeached, arrested, and punished.

sentences.zh: 每一檄下，耳目震新。

translations.literal: With every order issued, officials were shaken anew.
translations.idiomatic: Every order he issued sent a fresh shock through the bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 巡哨週嚴，遇盜輒擊之沉海，群魁奪氣，始有投誠意。

translations.literal: Patrols were strict on all sides; whenever bandits were met they were attacked and sunk at sea; the chieftains lost heart and only then showed intent to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Patrols were tightened on every side; pirates were attacked and sunk at sea. The chiefs lost heart and only then showed willingness to surrender.

sentences.zh: 張保妻鄭尤黠悍，遣硃爾賡額、溫承志往諭以利害，遂勸保降，要製府親臨乃聽命。

translations.literal: Zhang Bao's wife Zheng was especially cunning and fierce; he sent Zhu Ergene and Wen Chengzhi to explain advantage and harm, and they persuaded Bao to surrender, but Bao demanded that the governor-general come in person before he would obey.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bao's wife Zheng was especially cunning and fierce. He sent Zhu Ergene and Wen Chengzhi to explain the stakes, and they persuaded Bao to surrender, but Bao insisted the governor-general come in person before he would submit.

sentences.zh: 百齡曰：「粵人苦盜久矣！

translations.literal: Bai Ling said: "The people of Guangdong have suffered from bandits for so long!
translations.idiomatic: Bai Ling said: "The people of Guangdong have suffered from pirates long enough!

sentences.zh: 不坦懷待之，海氛何由息？」

translations.literal: If we do not receive them with open sincerity, how can the troubles at sea be stilled?"
translations.idiomatic: If we do not meet them openly and in good faith, how can the seas ever be calm?"

sentences.zh: 遂單舸出虎門，從者十數人，保率艦數百，轟砲如雷，環船跪迓，立撫其眾，許奏乞貸死。

translations.literal: He then went out alone in a small boat through Humen with only a dozen followers; Bao led several hundred ships, cannon thundering like thunder, surrounded the boat kneeling in welcome, immediately pacified his followers, and was permitted to memorialize begging mercy for his life.
translations.idiomatic: He then took a single boat through Humen with only a dozen attendants. Bao led hundreds of ships, cannon thundering, surrounded the boat kneeling in welcome, pacified his men on the spot, and was allowed to memorialize begging mercy for his life.

sentences.zh: 旬日解散二萬餘人，繳砲船四百餘號，復令誘烏石二至雷州斬之，釋其餘黨，粵洋肅清。

translations.literal: Within ten days more than twenty thousand were disbanded and more than four hundred gunboats surrendered; he again ordered that Wu Shier be lured to Leizhou and executed, released the remaining followers, and the Guangdong seas were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Within ten days more than twenty thousand men were disbanded and more than four hundred gunboats surrendered. He had Wu Shier lured to Leizhou and executed, released the remaining followers, and the Guangdong seas were pacified.

sentences.zh: 帝愈嘉異之，复太子少保，賜雙眼花翎，予輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: The emperor praised him all the more, restored him as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, bestowed the double-eyed peacock feather, and granted a hereditary commandant of light chariots.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him still more, restored him as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted the double-eyed peacock feather, and gave him a hereditary commandant of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 十六年，再乞病，回京，授刑部尚書，改左都御史，兼都統。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he again begged leave for illness, returned to the capital, was appointed minister of Punishments, changed to left censor-in-chief, and made concurrent banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he again asked leave for illness, returned to the capital, became minister of Punishments, then left censor-in-chief with a concurrent banner command.

sentences.zh: 未幾，授兩江總督。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 時河決王家營，上游綿拐山、李家樓並漫溢，論者謂河患在雲梯關海口不暢，多主改由馬港新河入海。

translations.literal: At the time the river burst at Wangjiaying; upstream at Mianguai Mountain and Lijialou it also overflowed; commentators said the river trouble lay in the Yuntiguan estuary not being free, and many favored changing course to enter the sea by the Magang new channel.
translations.idiomatic: The river had burst at Wangjiaying, and upstream at Mianguai Mountain and Lijialou it had also overflowed. Many argued the trouble lay in a choked estuary at Yuntiguan and favored diverting the river to the sea through the new Magang channel.

sentences.zh: 百齡親勘下游，疏言：「海口無高仰形跡，亦無攔門沙堤。

translations.literal: Bai Ling personally surveyed the lower reaches and memorialized: "At the estuary there is no sign of high elevation, nor any blocking sand bar.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Ling surveyed the lower reaches in person and reported: "The estuary shows no sign of being too high, and there is no blocking sand bar.

sentences.zh: 其受病在上年挑河二段內積淤三千餘丈。

translations.literal: The trouble lies in silt accumulated to more than three thousand zhang within the two dredged sections of last year.
translations.idiomatic: The real trouble is more than three thousand zhang of silt accumulated in the two dredged sections from the previous year.

sentences.zh: 又親至馬港口以下，見淤沙挑費更鉅，入海路窄。

translations.literal: He also went in person below Magangkou and saw that dredging silt would cost even more and the sea entry was narrow.
translations.idiomatic: He also went below Magangkou in person and found dredging would cost even more and the sea entry was too narrow.

sentences.zh: 二者相較，仍以修濬正河為便。

translations.literal: Comparing the two, it was still more convenient to repair and dredge the main channel.
translations.idiomatic: Comparing the two options, repairing and dredging the main channel was still the better course.

sentences.zh: 並請加挑灶工尾以下河身，兩岸接築新堤，於七套增建減水壩，修復王營減壩，重建磨盤埽。」
