translations.literal: He also asked to dredge further below Zaogongwei, build connecting new dikes on both banks, add flood-release dams at Qitao, restore the Wangying release dam, and rebuild the Millstone revetment."
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to dredge below Zaogongwei, build new connecting dikes on both banks, add flood-release dams at Qitao, restore the Wangying release dam, and rebuild the Millstone revetment."

sentences.zh: 詔如議。

translations.literal: An edict approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 百齡年逾六旬始生子，值帝萬壽日，聞之，賜名扎拉芬以示寵異，勉其盡心治河。

translations.literal: Bai Ling was over sixty when he first had a son; on the emperor's birthday the news reached him, and he bestowed the name Zhalafen to show special favor and urged him to devote himself wholeheartedly to river control.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Ling was over sixty when his first son was born. On the emperor's birthday he heard the news, named the boy Zhalafen to show special favor, and urged Bai Ling to devote himself fully to the river works.

sentences.zh: 次年春，諸工先後竣，漕運渡黃較早，迭加優賚，賜其子六品廕生。

translations.literal: The next spring the various works were completed in succession, grain transport crossed the Yellow River earlier than usual, he received repeated superior rewards, and his son was granted a sixth-rank yin privilege student.
translations.idiomatic: The next spring the works were finished in succession, grain transport crossed the Yellow River earlier than usual, he received repeated honors, and his son was granted sixth-rank yin privilege.

sentences.zh: 洪湖連年水漲，五壩壞其四，詔責急修。

translations.literal: Hong Lake had risen year after year; of five dams four were ruined, and an edict rebuked him and ordered urgent repair.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Lake had flooded several years running; four of five dams had failed, and an edict ordered urgent repairs.

sentences.zh: 百齡以禮壩之決，由於河督陳鳳翔急開遲閉，以致棘手，奏劾之。

translations.literal: Bai Ling held that the breach of the Li dam came from Canal Director Chen Fengxiang opening it too soon and closing it too late, making the situation difficult, and memorialized impeaching him.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Ling blamed the Li dam breach on Canal Director Chen Fengxiang opening it too soon and closing it too late, and impeached him.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔被嚴譴，訴道廳請開禮壩時，百齡同批允；

translations.literal: Fengxiang was severely rebuked; he appealed that when the circuit office asked to open the Li dam, Bai Ling had approved it in the same batch;
translations.idiomatic: Fengxiang was severely rebuked. He appealed that when the circuit office had asked to open the Li dam, Bai Ling had approved it in the same batch.

sentences.zh: 又訐淮揚道硃爾賡額為百齡所倚，司葦蕩營有弊。

translations.literal: he also accused Huai-Yang intendant Zhu Ergene of being relied on by Bai Ling and of abuses in managing the reed-marsh camp.
translations.idiomatic: He also accused Huai-Yang Intendant Zhu Ergene, whom Bai Ling favored, of abuses in the reed-marsh camp.

sentences.zh: 言官吳雲、馬履泰並論其舉劾失當，命松筠、初彭齡往按。

translations.literal: Censors Wu Yun and Ma Lutai both argued that his impeachments were improper; Songyun and Chu Pengling were ordered to go investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Censors Wu Yun and Ma Lutai both argued that his impeachments were improper. Songyun and Chu Pengling were sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 帝意方鄉用，議上，專坐硃爾賡額罪，以塞眾謗。

translations.literal: The emperor still intended to employ him; when the report came up, Zhu Ergene alone was convicted to silence public criticism.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor still meant to keep him in favor. When the report came up, only Zhu Ergene was convicted, to silence public criticism.

sentences.zh: 十八年，命協辦大學士，總督如故。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was ordered to serve as associate grand secretary while remaining governor as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was made associate grand secretary while retaining the governorship.

sentences.zh: 十九年，初彭齡奉命赴江蘇同查虧帑，議不合。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Chu Pengling was ordered to Jiangsu to investigate treasury deficits together with him; they did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year Chu Pengling was sent to Jiangsu to investigate treasury deficits with him, but they could not agree.

sentences.zh: 彭齡為所掣，恚甚，遂劾百齡受鹽場稅關餽遺，按之未得實，彭齡坐誣被譴。

translations.literal: Pengling was obstructed by him and was greatly angered; he then impeached Bai Ling for receiving gifts from salt fields and tax stations; investigation did not establish the facts, and Pengling was punished for false accusation.
translations.idiomatic: Frustrated by Bai Ling, Pengling impeached him for taking gifts from salt fields and tax stations. The charge was not proved, and Pengling was punished for a false accusation.

sentences.zh: 會鹽運使廖寅捕逆犯劉第五，部鞫為偽。

translations.literal: At the same time Salt Transport Commissioner Liao Yin captured rebel Liu Diwu; the ministry tried the case and found it false.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Salt Transport Commissioner Liao Yin arrested the rebel Liu Diwu, but the ministry found the case false.

sentences.zh: 百齡亦坐失入，褫宮銜，罷協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Bai Ling was also found guilty of wrongful conviction, stripped of palace rank, and removed as associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Ling was also blamed for the wrongful arrest, stripped of palace rank, and removed as associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 江南莠民散佈逆詞，連及百齡，嚴詔責捕。

translations.literal: Wicked commoners in Jiangnan spread seditious writings implicating Bai Ling, and a stern edict ordered capture.
translations.idiomatic: Wicked men in Jiangnan spread seditious writings implicating Bai Ling, and a stern edict ordered their arrest.

sentences.zh: 二十年，獲首、從方榮陞等百五十人，並抵法，复宮銜，封三等男爵，兼署安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year leaders and followers including Fang Rongsheng, one hundred fifty persons, were captured and all punished by law; his palace rank was restored, he was enfeoffed as a third-class baron, and concurrently acted as governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year one hundred fifty ringleaders and followers including Fang Rongsheng were captured and punished. His palace rank was restored, he was made a third-class baron, and he concurrently served as acting governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，病甚，命松筠往代，卒於江寧。

translations.literal: That winter, gravely ill, he was ordered replaced by Songyun; he died at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, gravely ill, he was replaced by Songyun and died at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 帝聞，悼惜，詔复協辦大學士，遣侍衛賜奠，許柩入城治喪。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard, he mourned and regretted it, ordered restoration as associate grand secretary, sent a bodyguard to bestow libation, and permitted the coffin to enter the city for funeral rites.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing the news the emperor mourned him, restored his associate grand secretary rank, sent a bodyguard with libations, and allowed his coffin into the city for funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 將遣皇子奠醊，既而以江北災民未能撫卹，停其奠醊，仍賜祭葬如例，諡文敏。

translations.literal: A prince was to be sent to offer libation, but because disaster victims in north of the river had not yet been comforted and relieved, the libation was suspended; funeral sacrifices and burial honors were still granted as usual, posthumous name Wenmin.
translations.idiomatic: A prince was to offer libation, but because disaster victims north of the river had not yet been relieved, that honor was withheld. Funeral honors were still granted as usual, and he received the posthumous name Wenmin, "Cultivated and Quick."

sentences.zh: 子扎拉芬，襲男爵。

translations.literal: His son Zhalafen inherited the barony.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhalafen inherited the barony.

sentences.zh: 伯麟，字玉亭，瑚錫哈哩氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Bolin, style name Yuting, of the Huxihali clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Bolin, whose style was Yuting, belonged to the Huxihali clan and the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 由繙譯舉人授兵部筆​​帖式，擢右春坊右贊善，累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: From translator licentiate he was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of War, was promoted to right assistant in the Eastern Palace, and rose repeatedly to cabinet academician.
translations.idiomatic: From translator licentiate he became a clerk in the Ministry of War, rose to right assistant in the Eastern Palace, and eventually became a cabinet academician.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十七年，授盛京兵部侍郎，尋授山西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year of Qianlong he was appointed vice minister of War at Mukden, then governor of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 57 he became vice minister of War at Mukden, then governor of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶九年，擢雲貴總督。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Jiaqing he was promoted to governor-general of Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 9 he became governor-general of Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十年，緬甸與暹羅屬夷戛於臘構釁，求助於孟連土司刀派功，往援遇害，失其印。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Kayin of Siam's dependency Gayaungla provoked trouble with Burma; he sought help from Menglian native chief Dao Paigong, who went to aid and was killed, losing his seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Gayaungla, a dependency of Siam, provoked Burma. It sought help from Menglian native chief Dao Paigong, who was killed on the expedition and lost his seal.

sentences.zh: 伯麟以刀派功禍由自取，惟責暹羅繳所得印。

translations.literal: Bolin held that Dao Paigong brought disaster on himself and only demanded that Siam surrender the seal taken.
translations.idiomatic: Bolin held that Dao Paigong had brought disaster on himself and only demanded that Siam return the captured seal.

sentences.zh: 十一年，緬甸請預期納貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Burma asked to pay tribute ahead of schedule.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Burma asked to pay tribute early.

sentences.zh: 伯麟知其與暹羅構兵，為求助地，卻之。

translations.literal: Bolin knew it was at war with Siam and sought a place to ask for help; he refused.
translations.idiomatic: Bolin knew Burma was at war with Siam and only wanted help, so he refused.

sentences.zh: 後緬甸為戛於臘所敗，果來乞援，伯麟拒勿應，戛於臘旋亦敗走。

translations.literal: Later Burma was defeated by Gayaungla and indeed came begging for aid; Bolin refused to respond, and Gayaungla soon was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Later Burma was defeated by Gayaungla and did beg for aid. Bolin refused, and Gayaungla was soon defeated and driven off.

sentences.zh: 緬兵次車里土司界，嚴兵守邊，移檄訓戒，緬兵遂退。

translations.literal: Burmese troops approached the Cheli native chief's border; he strengthened border defense and sent a dispatch of admonition, and the Burmese troops withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When Burmese troops approached the Cheli native chief's border, he strengthened defenses and sent a warning dispatch, and the Burmese withdrew.

sentences.zh: 迤南江外倮匪入邊劫掠，遣普洱鎮總兵那林泰剿平之。

translations.literal: Luo bandits south of the river beyond the frontier entered the border to plunder; he sent Pu'er garrison commander Na Lintai to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Luo bandits beyond the frontier south of the river raided the border. He sent Pu'er Garrison Commander Na Lintai to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 十三年，緬甸四大萬頭目來請十三板納地，伯麟責其冒昧，諭以十三板納為九龍江土司所轄，俱屬內地，毋生覬覦，詔嘉其得體。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Burma's four major chiefs came requesting the land of Shisanbanna; Bolin rebuked their presumption and instructed that Shisanbanna was under the Jiulongjiang native chief, all within inner territory, and they must not covet it; an edict praised his propriety.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Burma's four major chiefs asked for Shisanbanna. Bolin rebuked their presumption and told them Shisanbanna belonged to the Jiulongjiang native chief within imperial territory and must not be coveted. The emperor praised his handling.

sentences.zh: 十四年，入覲，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he came to audience and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he came to audience and received the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 十七年，騰越邊外野寨頭目拉幹出擾，遣兵擒之。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year wild stockade chief Lagan beyond the Tengyue border came out to harass; troops were sent and he was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year wild stockade chief Lagan beyond the Tengyue border raided the frontier. Troops were sent and he was captured.

sentences.zh: 緬寧、騰越要隘舊設土練一千六百名，久廢，規復其制，給曠土耕種。

translations.literal: At strategic passes in Mienning and Tengyue, native militia of sixteen hundred had long been abolished; he planned to restore the system and grant idle land for cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: At key passes in Mienning and Tengyue, a native militia of sixteen hundred had long been disbanded. He restored the system and granted idle land for farming.

sentences.zh: 僧銅金從倮夷李文明為亂，已悔罪投誠，更姓名為張輔國，充南興土目；

translations.literal: The monk Tongjin had followed the Luo rebel Li Wenming in rebellion, had repented and submitted, changed his name to Zhang Fuguo, and served as Nanxing native officer;
translations.idiomatic: The monk Tongjin had followed the Luo rebel Li Wenming, then repented and submitted, changed his name to Zhang Fuguo, and served as Nanxing native officer.

sentences.zh: 至是復勾結倮眾侵擾，伯麟赴緬寧督土司會剿。

translations.literal: at this time he again colluded with Luo followers to raid; Bolin went to Mienning to direct the native chiefs in joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Now he colluded with Luo followers again and raided the border. Bolin went to Mienning to direct the native chiefs in a joint campaign.

sentences.zh: 十八年正月，進逼南興，破其巢，輔國就戮，邊境肅清。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighteenth year he advanced on Nanxing, broke their lair, Fuguo was executed, and the border was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighteenth year he advanced on Nanxing, destroyed their stronghold, executed Fuguo, and pacified the border.

sentences.zh: 增設騰越鎮馬鹿塘、大壩二汛。

translations.literal: He added garrison posts at Malutang and Daba under Tengyue command.
translations.idiomatic: He added garrison posts at Malutang and Daba under Tengyue command.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，臨安邊外夷人高羅衣自稱窩泥王，偽署官職，糾眾萬餘，攻殺土目龍定國，擾瓦渣、溪處兩土司境，渡江窺伺內地，伯麟親往剿平之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, the frontier tribesman Gao Luoyi beyond Lin'an styled himself King of the Woni, falsely appointed offices, gathered more than ten thousand followers, attacked and killed native officer Long Dingguo, disturbed the territories of the Wazha and Xichu native chiefs, crossed the river to spy on the inner districts, and Bolin went in person to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the frontier tribesman Gao Luoyi beyond Lin'an called himself King of the Woni, set up a false government, gathered more than ten thousand followers, killed native officer Long Dingguo, raided the Wazha and Xichu chiefdoms, and crossed the river to threaten the interior. Bolin went in person and suppressed him.

sentences.zh: 議定善後條規，使各土司綏靖夷民，以安反側。

translations.literal: He deliberated and fixed follow-up regulations so that each native chief might pacify the tribes and settle those inclined to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: He drew up follow-up regulations so each native chief could pacify the tribes and calm those inclined to rebel.

sentences.zh: 敘功，加太子少保。

translations.literal: His merit was reviewed and he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 尋命協辦大學士，仍留總督任。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was ordered to serve as associate grand secretary while retaining the governorship.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made associate grand secretary while keeping the governorship.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，羅衣從侄高老五竄藤條江外復為亂，擾及郡城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Luoyi's nephew Gao Laowu fled beyond the Tengtiao River and rebelled again, disturbing even the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Luoyi's nephew Gao Laowu fled beyond the Tengtiao River and rebelled again, troubling even the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 督師剿擒之，餘黨悉殲。

translations.literal: He commanded troops to suppress and capture him; the remaining followers were all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: He led troops who captured him and destroyed the remaining followers.

sentences.zh: 增設臨安江內東、西兩路要隘塘汛官兵，以江外煙瘴最盛，降夷就撫，裁撤留防兵練。

translations.literal: He added garrison troops at strategic passes on the eastern and western routes within Lin'an on the river; because miasma beyond the river was strongest, when surrendered tribes were pacified he cut the remaining defensive militia.
translations.idiomatic: He added garrison troops at key passes on the eastern and western routes within Lin'an. Because miasma was worst beyond the river, once surrendered tribes were pacified he cut the remaining defensive militia.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，召授兵部尚書，兼都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was summoned and appointed minister of War, concurrently banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was recalled as minister of War with a concurrent banner command.

sentences.zh: 复疏陳滇、黔邊務六事，如議行。

translations.literal: Again he memorialized six matters on Yunnan-Guizhou frontier affairs, and they were implemented as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: He again memorialized six points on Yunnan-Guizhou frontier affairs, and they were adopted.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，拜體仁閣大學士，管理兵部。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he was appointed grand secretary of the Hall of Embodied Benevolence and managed the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1 he became grand secretary of the Hall of Embodied Benevolence and headed the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 尋以年老休致，仍充實錄館總裁。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward, on account of age he retired, but still served as director of the Veritable Records Office.
translations.idiomatic: He soon retired on account of age but remained director of the Veritable Records Office.

sentences.zh: 三年，萬壽節，與十五老臣宴。

translations.literal: In the third year, on the Longevity Festival, he banqueted with fifteen elder ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was among fifteen elder ministers at the Longevity Festival banquet.

sentences.zh: 逾年，卒，諡文慎。

translations.literal: After a year he died, posthumous name Wenshen.
translations.idiomatic: He died the following year and received the posthumous name Wenshen, "Cultivated and Prudent."

sentences.zh: 伯麟任邊圻凡十六年，廉潔愛民，士林尤感戴之。

translations.literal: Bolin served on the frontier for sixteen years in all, was incorrupt and loved the people, and the scholarly class especially revered him.
translations.idiomatic: Bolin served on the frontier for sixteen years, was honest and devoted to the people, and was especially revered by scholars.

sentences.zh: 還朝後，以旗人生計為憂，疏陳調劑事宜，深中利弊。

translations.literal: After returning to court, concerned for Bannermen's livelihood, he memorialized measures of adjustment that struck deeply at advantage and harm.
translations.idiomatic: After returning to court he memorialized on Bannermen's livelihood with remedies that cut to the heart of the problem.

sentences.zh: 論者謂有名臣風。

translations.literal: Commentators said he had the bearing of a renowned minister.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators said he had the bearing of a great minister.

sentences.zh: 論曰：仁宗倚畀疆臣，膺重寄者，多參揆席。

translations.literal: The commentary says: The Renzong Emperor relied on frontier ministers; those who bore heavy trust often held seats in the grand secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: The Renzong Emperor relied on frontier ministers, and many who bore heavy responsibility held seats in the grand secretariat.

sentences.zh: 書麟、吉慶並勤勞軍事，而盡瘁辱身，有幸不幸焉。

translations.literal: Shu Lin and Jiqing both toiled in military affairs, yet exhausted themselves and suffered disgrace—there is fortune and misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Lin and Jiqing both labored hard in military affairs yet wore themselves out and suffered disgrace; fortune and misfortune are not evenly shared.

sentences.zh: 長麟、費淳先後治吳，一嚴一寬，才德互有優絀。

translations.literal: Zhanglin and Fei Chun governed Wu in succession, one strict and one lenient; in talent and virtue each had strengths and weaknesses.
translations.idiomatic: Zhanglin and Fei Chun governed the Jiangnan region in turn, one strict and one lenient; each had his own strengths and weaknesses in talent and character.

sentences.zh: 百齡號能臣之冠，機牙鋒銳，凌轢一時，晚節乃招物議。

translations.literal: Bai Ling was called the foremost capable minister; his wit was sharp, he overwhelmed his age, yet in his later years he drew public criticism.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Ling was called the foremost capable minister of his day: sharp, aggressive, and dominant for a time, yet his later years drew public criticism.

sentences.zh: 如伯麟之安邊坐鎮，遺愛不湮，識量豈易及哉？

translations.literal: As for Bolin's securing the frontier and holding his post, his lingering benevolence undimmed—how easily could such breadth of judgment be matched?
translations.idiomatic: As for Bolin, who secured the frontier and held his post while his benevolence endured—who could easily match such judgment?
